text: A car travels at 60 km/h for 2 hours. What is the distance covered?
explanation: Distance = Speed × Time = 60 × 2 = 120 km.

text: Convert 90 km/h into m/s.
explanation: To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. 90 × 5/18 = 25 m/s.

text: A person covers 150 km in 3 hours. What is his speed?
explanation: Speed = Distance / Time = 150 / 3 = 50 km/h.

text: A bus travels at 80 km/h. How long does it take to cover 200 km?
explanation: Time = Distance / Speed = 200 / 80 = 2.5 hours.

text: A man walks at 5 km/h for 2 hours and then at 3 km/h for 3 hours. What is his average speed?
explanation: Total distance = 5×2 + 3×3 = 10 + 9 = 19 km. Total time = 2 + 3 = 5 hours. Average speed = 19/5 = 3.8 km/h.

text: Two cars are moving in the same direction at 40 km/h and 60 km/h. What is their relative speed?
explanation: Relative speed in same direction = 60 − 40 = 20 km/h.

text: Two trains of lengths 180 m and 220 m are running in opposite directions at speeds of 54 km/h and 72 km/h respectively. How much time will they take to completely cross each other?
explanation: Relative speed (opposite direction) = 54 + 72 = 126 km/h = 126 × 5/18 = 35 m/s. Total length = 180 + 220 = 400 m. Time = 400/35 = 11.43 sec.

text: A boat can travel 36 km downstream in 3 hours and 24 km upstream in 4 hours. Find the speed of the stream.
explanation: Downstream speed = 36/3 = 12 km/h. Upstream speed = 24/4 = 6 km/h. Speed of stream = (12 − 6)/2 = 3 km/h.

text: A and B start simultaneously from two places 420 km apart toward each other. A travels at 40 km/h and B at 30 km/h. After how many hours will they meet?
explanation: Relative speed = 40 + 30 = 70 km/h. Time = 420/70 = 6 hr.

text: Two runners start simultaneously around a circular track of length 600 m. Their speeds are 6 m/s and 9 m/s. After how much time will they meet again at the starting point?
explanation: Time for first runner to complete one lap = 600/6 = 100 sec. Time for second runner = 600/9 = 66.67 sec. LCM of 100 and 200/3: LCM = 200 sec.

text: A man running at 8 km/h crosses a train moving in the opposite direction in 9 sec. If the train length is 180 m, find its speed.
explanation: Relative speed = 180/9 = 20 m/s. Man speed = 8 × 5/18 = 2.22 m/s. Since opposite direction, train speed = 20 − 2.22 = 17.78 m/s = 17.78 × 18/5 = 64 km/h.

text: A car travels first half distance at 30 km/h and second half at 60 km/h. What is the average speed?
explanation: Average speed for equal distances = 2ab/(a+b) = 2×30×60/90 = 3600/90 = 40 km/h.

text: A 240 m train crosses a platform in 24 sec and a pole in 12 sec. Find platform length.
explanation: Speed from pole crossing = 240/12 = 20 m/s. Distance covered crossing platform = 20 × 24 = 480 m. Platform length = 480 − 240 = 240 m.

text: A swimmer can swim at 5 km/h in still water. Stream speed is 3 km/h. If he swims perpendicular to stream for 1 hour, how far downstream does he drift?
explanation: Drift depends only on stream speed = 3 × 1 = 3 km.

text: A train 150 m long passes a signal in 15 sec. What is its speed?
Two cyclists start together around a 500 m track at 5 m/s and 7 m/s. After how much time will they meet first?
explanation: Relative speed = 7 − 5 = 2 m/s. Time for faster to gain one full lap = 500/2 = 250 sec.

text: A boat travels 30 km upstream in 5 hr and same downstream in 3 hr. Find the boat speed in still water.
explanation: Upstream speed = 30/5 = 6 km/h. Downstream speed = 30/3 = 10 km/h. Still water speed = (10+6)/2 = 8 km/h.

text: A person walks at 4 km/h and reaches office 10 min late. At 5 km/h he reaches 5 min early. Find the distance.
A man rows 15 km downstream in 1 hr and returns in 3 hr. Find the speed of the stream.
explanation: Downstream speed = 15/1 = 15 km/h. Upstream speed = 15/3 = 5 km/h. Stream speed = (15−5)/2 = 5 km/h.

text: A train running at 108 km/h crosses a bridge in 40 sec and a pole in 16 sec. Find the bridge length.
explanation: Speed = 108 × 5/18 = 30 m/s. Train length = 30 × 16 = 480 m. Total distance crossing bridge = 30 × 40 = 1200 m. Bridge length = 1200 − 480 = 720 m.

text: If speed increases by 20%, time reduces by what percentage?
explanation: Time is inversely proportional to speed. New time factor = 1/1.2 = 5/6. Reduction = 1 − 5/6 = 1/6 = 16.67%.

text: A thief is spotted 200 m away and police starts chasing at 8 m/s while thief runs at 5 m/s. How much time to catch the thief?
explanation: Relative speed = 8 − 5 = 3 m/s. Time = 200/3 = 66.67 sec.

text: A runner completes a race in 12 min. If speed increases by 25%, what is the new time?
explanation: New speed = 1.25 × original. New time = 12/1.25 = 9.6 min = 9 min 36 sec.

text: A train 300 m long crosses another 200 m train moving in the opposite direction in 10 sec. If one train's speed is 54 km/h, find the other's speed.
explanation: Total length = 300 + 200 = 500 m. Relative speed = 500/10 = 50 m/s = 180 km/h. Other train speed = 180 − 54 = 126 km/h.

text: Two boats travel equal distances upstream and downstream. Ratio of times is 5:3. What is the ratio of boat speed to stream speed?
explanation: Time upstream : downstream = 5:3. So speed downstream : upstream = 5:3. (b+s):(b−s) = 5:3. 3(b+s) = 5(b−s). 3b+3s = 5b−5s. 8s = 2b. b/s = 4. Ratio = 4:1.

text: A car covers 20% distance at 40 km/h and remaining 80% at 60 km/h. What is the average speed?
explanation: Let total distance = 100 km. Time for 20 km at 40 = 0.5 hr. Time for 80 km at 60 = 4/3 hr. Total time = 0.5 + 4/3 = 11/6 hr. Average speed = 100/(11/6) = 600/11 = 54.55 km/h.

text: A train takes 20 sec to cross a man and 30 sec to cross a platform. If speed is 54 km/h, find the platform length.
explanation: Speed = 54 × 5/18 = 15 m/s. Train length = 15 × 20 = 300 m. Total distance crossing platform = 15 × 30 = 450 m. Platform length = 450 − 300 = 150 m.

text: A train crosses a platform twice its own length in 36 sec. If speed is 15 m/s, find the train length.
explanation: Platform = 2 × train length. Total distance = train + 2×train = 3×train. 3 × train = 15 × 36 = 540 m. Train length = 540/3 = 180 m.

text: A boat takes twice as long to go upstream as downstream. What is the ratio of stream speed to still water speed?
explanation: Let downstream time = t, upstream = 2t. For same distance: (b+s)×t = (b−s)×2t. b+s = 2b−2s. 3s = b. Stream:Still water = s:3s = 1:3.

text: A cyclist covers 1/3 distance at 20 km/h, next 1/3 at 30 km/h and remaining at 60 km/h. What is the average speed?
Two trains 100 m and 150 m long move in same direction at 45 km/h and 60 km/h. Time taken to cross each other?
A man can row 24 km downstream in 4 hr and upstream in 8 hr. How long will he take to cover 18 km in still water?
explanation: Downstream speed = 24/4 = 6 km/h. Upstream speed = 24/8 = 3 km/h. Still water speed = (6+3)/2 = 4.5 km/h. Time = 18/4.5 = 4 hr.

text: Two athletes, A and B, start running simultaneously around a circular stadium of circumference 900 m. A runs at 8 m/s while B runs at 5 m/s. How many times will A overtake B in the first 20 minutes?
explanation: Relative speed = 8 − 5 = 3 m/s. Time for one overtake = 900/3 = 300 sec. 20 min = 1200 sec. Number of overtakes = 1200/300 = 4.

text: A train crosses a small platform in 18 seconds and a larger platform in 30 seconds. The larger platform is 180 m longer than the smaller one. If the train moves at a constant speed, find the speed of the train.
explanation: Difference in time = 30 − 18 = 12 sec. In 12 sec, train covers the extra 180 m of the larger platform. Speed = 180/12 = 15 m/s.

text: Two trains of equal length enter a tunnel 500 m long from opposite ends simultaneously. They are moving at 72 km/h and 54 km/h respectively and completely cross each other inside the tunnel in 12 seconds. Find the length of each train.
explanation: Relative speed = 72 + 54 = 126 km/h = 35 m/s. Total length of both trains = 35 × 12 = 420 m. Each train = 420/2 = 210 m.
